|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 1 June 2002). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' ([[I Find Your Lack Of Faith Disturbing (V) (Virtual Set 2)]]): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #2 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 1 June 2002; first release date unknown). Full text: “Plays on table. While Deep Hatred not on table, opponent may only use 1 combat card per turn. While opponent has 2 Jedi on Naboo, you lose no more than 2 Force to Force drains at opponent's Naboo sites. We'll Handle This may only target droids and spies.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Plays on table. Unless Deep Hatred on table, opponent may use only one combat card per turn. While opponent has two Jedi on Naboo, you lose no more than 2 Force to Force drains at opponent’s Naboo sites. We’ll Handle This may target only droids and spies.” '''What changed:''' “While” → “Unless”; removed “not”; added “use”; “use 1” → “one”; “2” → “two”; “opponent's” → “opponent’s”; “We'll” → “We’ll”; moved “target” to a different place in the text.
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024153738/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards2.pdf#page=4 VirtualCards2.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006; page 4, slip 35. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[I Find Your Lack Of Faith Disturbing]].
* Full-card remaster: [[Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour#Cards|Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour]] (fan reconstruction, 2026).
